title: How Auction Mechanisms (Dutch, English, Sealed-Bid) Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Seller lists asset] --> B{Auction type}
    B --> C
    B --> F
    B --> I
    subgraph Dutch/GDA
      C[Price decays over time]
      C --> D["Compute current spot price"]
      D --> E[First bid at spot price wins]
    end
    subgraph English
      F[Bids ascend, outbidding]
      F --> G[Refund superseded bids]
      G --> H[Highest bid at expiry wins]
    end
    subgraph Sealed-Bid
      I["Commit hashed bid"]
      I --> J[Reveal phase]
      J --> K[Highest valid reveal wins]
    end
    E --> L["Settle: transfer asset and funds"]
    H --> L
    K --> L

title: Attack Vector
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Adversary observes auction] --> B{Failure layer}
    B --> C
    B --> G
    B --> K
    subgraph Price-Curve Math
      C["Divide before multiply"]
      C --> D["volume / price rounds down"]
      D --> E["Low-decimal token rounds to 0"]
      E --> F[Bidder pays, receives nothing]
    end
    subgraph Lifecycle
      G[Unvalidated start/end times]
      G --> H[Auction never ends or starts]
      H --> I[Split finalize closes early]
      I --> J[Reserves and NFT stranded]
    end
    subgraph Mempool Ordering
      K[See pending bid or reveal]
      K --> L[Front-run reveal or snipe block]
      L --> M[Grief: bid then withdraw]
      M --> N[Honest party loses value]
    end

title: Defense Pattern
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Bid and settlement] --> B[Multiply before divide]
    B --> C[Refund division remainder to bidder]
    C --> D{Claim rounds to zero?}
    D -->|Yes| E[Revert dust bid]
    D -->|No| F[Proceed to lifecycle checks]
    F --> G["Validate start < end timestamps"]
    G --> H["Enforce MIN_PRICE on decayed price"]
    H --> I["Atomic finalize: asset plus funds"]
    I --> J[Commit-reveal hides sealed bids]
    J --> K[No-bid recovery path]
    K --> L[Auction settles safely]
